name: What are common water-efficient bathroom upgrades?
description: Common water-efficient bathroom upgrades include low-flow toilets, water-saving showerheads, faucet aerators, and on-demand hot water recirculation pumps.

mainEntity.name: What are common water-efficient bathroom upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common water-efficient bathroom upgrades include installing low-flow toilets, water-saving showerheads, and faucet aerators. Beyond fixtures, consider on-demand hot water recirculation pumps, which reduce the wait time for hot water and prevent wasted cold water. These upgrades are effective in reducing overall water consumption in homes.
